evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-memory

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fooxe/dsh-memory) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-green)

**English** | [**中文版**](#中文版)

## English

**Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness — the Claude Code memory model: your agents remember across sessions, wake up with context, and never mix projects. Pure files, zero dependencies.**

## What it does

> Your DSH agent meets you for the "first time" — **every single session**.
> With dsh-memory, it remembers.

```text
Session 1   You: "Remember — this project uses pnpm, not npm."
            Agent: saved via memory_save

Session 2   You: "Which package manager do we use?"
            Agent: "pnpm — you told me yesterday."   <- no re-asking, ever
```

No server, no account, no embedding provider. Just plain markdown files — delete the directory and that scope forgets everything.

## Highlights

### 🖥️ A visual memory manager, not a markdown dump

**Settings → Memory** opens a full manager: every memory from both scopes in one searchable list, workspaces as an expandable tree (nested sub-project scopes discovered automatically), sub-folder grouping, and live guard gauges (index lines / KB / file count). Add, rewrite, tag, or delete any memory **right in the panel** — through the exact same guarded pipeline as the agent's own tool calls, so what you fix in the UI is precisely what the model sees next session.

### 👆 Touch activation — CLAUDE.md semantics (v0.13)

Project memories carry sub-directory tags. A tag injects when the session's working directory sits inside it — **or the moment the session touches it**: one `read`/`edit`/`write`/`grep`/`glob`/`bash`/`pwsh` call into `frontend/src` activates `[frontend]` and `[frontend/src]` for the rest of the session. Activation is monotone and survives session resume — exactly like nested CLAUDE.md files, triggered by what you actually do, not just where you `cd`'d at launch.

Untouched areas are hinted, never silently hidden: `+3 more tagged to areas you haven't touched — memory_search surfaces them.`

### 🧠 Session-scoped — reads and writes agree

Each session's prompt carries ITS workspace's memories, and `memory_save` lands in that same workspace. Multi-session web hosts get zero cross-workspace bleed.

### 📉 Bounded by design

Root-level memories always inject; area memories load on work/touch; a 25-entry injection cap plus hard limits — 200 lines / 25 KB index, 500 memories per scope — keep the prompt flat no matter how much you remember.

### 🔒 Safety in the plumbing

Atomic writes (a crash never leaves half a file) · secrets refused on **every** write path, panel included · cross-origin + method gate on the panel API · traversal-proof ids · `$HOME`, drive roots and tmp dirs can never become a project scope (Windows-aware guards).

### 🪶 Zero dependencies

Nothing to provision, nothing to break. Lean hosts degrade gracefully — every optional host service is read defensively, tools keep working without them.

## Quick start

**Prerequisite**: the DSH CLI — `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`. From a source checkout, prefix commands with `pnpm`.

**1 · Install (one command)**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @fooxe/dsh-memory        # DSH CLI installed
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @fooxe/dsh-memory   # from a source checkout
```

`--profile` is **required** and goes **before** `add` — pick the profile you actually boot (`web` for the Web UI; see `~/.dsh/profiles/`). Manual `npm i -g @fooxe/dsh-memory` + `dsh web --patch ./overlay/dsh-memory.cordis.yml` also works, but `plugin add` is the recommended path.

**2 · Restart DSH — the step everyone misses**

Tools register **only at service startup**. Stop the service (Ctrl+C), start it again, then open a **new** chat.

**3 · Verify (30 seconds)**

Say *"Remember that I prefer pnpm over npm."* → a `memory_save` call appears. Open a **new** session and ask *"Which package manager do I prefer?"* → answered from the injected index. `~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md` now exists; inside a project, decisions land in `<project-root>/.dsh/memory/` — commit it and the whole team shares it.

### Troubleshooting (every row battle-tested on a real install)

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `dsh: command not found` | Install the DSH CLI first — see Prerequisite |
| `required option '--profile <name>'` | It goes **before** the subcommand: `dsh plugin --profile web add ...` |
| pnpm `ERR_P..._STORE: Unexpected store location` | Your terminal pnpm differs from DSH's bundled one (11.7.0). Delete the profile dir (`~/.dsh/profiles/web`) and re-run `plugin add` — it rebuilds cleanly |
| Installed + restarted, still no memory tools | Check startup logs for `warning: ... did not activate`, and `dsh --profile web --dump-config \| grep fooxe` to confirm the tree entry; file an issue with the log if it persists |
| `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` after install | Harmless here (zero native deps); `pnpm approve-builds` in the profile dir clears it |
| `plugin add` installs an **old version** | Your default registry (a mirror) lags behind npmjs. Pin explicitly: `npx pnpm@11.7.0 add @fooxe/dsh-memory@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`, or add `@fooxe:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` to `~/.npmrc` |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `memory_save` | Save a durable memory; scope defaults to project inside a detected project root, user elsewhere |
| `memory_search` | Case-insensitive keyword search across both scopes (ids, titles, tags, content) |
| `memory_read` | Read one full memory — Claude Code's `project_memory_read` field contract (`content?`, `local_file?`, `size_bytes`, `updated_at`, `truncated`) |
| `memory_list` | Recent memories per scope, newest first |

Tool descriptions embed proactive-save guidance — preferences, decisions and key facts get saved without being asked; secrets never do.

**Write rules (ported from Claude Code / Gemini CLI practice):**
- **Strong-evidence gate** — before saving, the model asks *"will this still matter a month from now?"*; unsure → skip (noise costs more than gaps)
- **Dedupe-and-update** — same-topic saves update the memory in place instead of appending duplicates
- **Dated index lines** — every entry carries `YYYY-MM-DD`, so the model reasons fresh-vs-stale at injection time
- **Secret refusal** — credentials/tokens/passwords are refused out loud, on every write path

## When · what · which scope

**Save when**: a preference or correction is stated (corrections are the highest-value memories), a decision is made, a key number/ID appears, an error+fix closes. **Never**: secrets, transient state, anything directly readable from the repo, unconfirmed guesses.

**Which scope** — the one-line test: is this fact about *the person* or about *this project*?

| User scope `~/.dsh/memory` | Project scope `<project-root>/.dsh/memory` |
|---|---|
| Personal preferences (pnpm, Chinese comments) | Technical decisions (A over B, because C) |
| Working habits (test before commit) | Conventions (layout, naming, build commands) |
| Cross-project lessons | Key numbers / IDs (ports, servers, app IDs) |
| Communication style | Anything the team should share through the repo |

Still true in a different project? → user scope. Only true here? → project scope.

## How it works

**Two physically isolated stores** — user `~/.dsh/memory` and project `<project-root>/.dsh/memory` — that can never mix. The project root is auto-detected by a priority chain, clearest signal first:

1. `DSH_MEMORY_PROJECT_DIR` env override
2. An existing `.dsh/memory` marker above (supports nested sub-project scopes)
3. Any VCS root above: `.git` / `.svn` / `.hg`
4. The host workspace registry (DSH's official project registry)
5. The current directory itself — VCS-less projects get their own scope

**Storage layout**

```
~/.dsh/memory/                      <- user scope (personal, cross-project)
|-- MEMORY.md                       <- guarded index, newest first
|-- memories/20261004-181500-prefer-pnpm.md
<project-root>/.dsh/memory/         <- project scope (team-shared, commit it)
```

**Injection** happens at session start via `ctx.systemPrompt`: user memories always; project root-level memories always; path-tagged memories when the tag hits the session's working-directory chain **or a touched directory's chain** (see Touch activation above); untouched tags counted in the hint line; 25-entry cap on top of the scope-level guards.

## Verification

```sh
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # 64 tests, zero type errors
```

Unit + type compile against the shipped official types + runtime smoke (real `defineTool`, end-to-end save → search → read → list) + a real-cordis activation guard, with CI on Ubuntu **and** Windows.

dsh-memory happily coexists with DSH's official MCP memory options — pick whichever fits your workflow, or use both.

# 中文版

**给 DeepSeek Harness 装上跨会话持久记忆——Claude Code 的记忆模型：你的 agent 记得住、醒得来、项目之间不串味。纯文件、零依赖。**（[English](#english)）

## 这个插件做什么

> 你的 DSH agent 每次开会话都是"初次见面"。
> 装上 dsh-memory，它记得你。

```text
会话 1   你："记住——这个项目用 pnpm，不用 npm。"
         Agent：memory_save 已保存

会话 2   你："我们用什么包管理器？"
         Agent："pnpm——你昨天告诉我的。"   <- 从此不用重复解释
```

无服务端、无账号、无 embedding——只有纯 markdown 文件，删掉目录就是彻底遗忘。

## 亮点

### 🖥️ 可视化记忆管理器，不是一堆 markdown

打开 **Settings → Memory**：双域全部记忆一屏可搜、工作区树形展开（嵌套子项目自动发现）、子文件夹分组、护栏仪表实时可见（行数 / KB / 文件数）。**面板内直接**新增、改写、打标签、删除任意记忆——和 agent 工具调用走同一条带护栏管线，你在界面改的就是模型下次看到的。

### 👆 触碰激活——CLAUDE.md 语义（v0.13）

项目记忆带子目录标签。标签命中会话工作目录（含祖先链）时注入——**会话触碰它的那一刻也注入**：一次 `read`/`edit`/`write`/`grep`/`glob`/`bash`/`pwsh` 调用进了 `frontend/src`，`[frontend]` 和 `[frontend/src]` 立即激活并保持到会话结束。单调递增、会话恢复后仍在——和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 完全同理，由你实际做了什么触发，而不只是启动时 `cd` 在哪。

未触碰区域不静默隐藏，始终提示：`+3 more tagged to areas you haven't touched — memory_search surfaces them.`

### 🧠 会话级——读写同桶

每个会话的提示词携带**它自己工作区**的记忆，保存也落进同一个工作区——多会话 web 宿主零串味。

### 📉 天生防膨胀

根级记忆恒注入；区域记忆工作/触碰才加载；注入 25 条上限 + 硬护栏（每域 200 行 / 25KB 索引、500 条）——记得再多也不撑爆上下文。

### 🔒 管线内置安全

原子写入（崩溃不留半截文件）· **所有**写入路径拒存密钥（面板也算）· 面板 API 跨源 + method 双栅栏 · 防 id 路径穿越 · `$HOME`、盘符根、tmp 目录永不成为项目作用域（Windows 感知）。

### 🪶 零依赖

没有要部署的、没有会坏的。精简宿主优雅降级——可选宿主服务全部防御式读取，缺了工具照常工作。

## 快速开始

**前置**：先装 DSH 本体——`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`（源码检出则命令加 `pnpm` 前缀）。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @fooxe/dsh-memory        # 已装 DSH CLI
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @fooxe/dsh-memory   # 源码检出方式
```

`--profile` **必填**且放在 `add` 前面——填你实际启动的 profile（Web 界面就是 `web`；已有哪些看 `~/.dsh/profiles/`）。

装完**必须重启 DSH**（工具只在启动时注册），再开新会话说*"记住我喜欢 pnpm"*验证。`~/.dsh/memory/MEMORY.md` 随之出现；项目内决策落在 `<项目根>/.dsh/memory/`——提交版本库全组共享。

### 安装排障（每行来自真实安装实测）

| 症状 | 解法 |
|---|---|
| `dsh: command not found` | DSH 本体没装，看前置步骤 |
| `required option '--profile <name>'` | 参数放在子命令**前面**：`dsh plugin --profile web add ...` |
| pnpm `ERR_P..._STORE: Unexpected store location` | 终端 pnpm 与 DSH 自带（11.7.0）不一致——删掉整个 profile 目录（`~/.dsh/profiles/web`）重跑 `plugin add`，全新重建 |
| 装了也重启了还是没有记忆工具 | 看启动日志 `warning: ... did not activate`；跑 `dsh --profile web --dump-config \| grep fooxe` 确认在插件树里；仍在就把日志发 issue |
| `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` | 对本插件无害（零原生依赖）；profile 目录跑 `pnpm approve-builds` 清掉 |
| `plugin add` 装到**旧版本** | 默认源（镜像）滞后。显式官方源：`npx pnpm@11.7.0 add @fooxe/dsh-memory@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`；或 `~/.npmrc` 加 `@fooxe:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org` |

## 四个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `memory_save` | 保存持久记忆；项目内默认存项目级，否则存用户级 |
| `memory_search` | 大小写不敏感关键词检索（id/标题/标签/正文，跨双域） |
| `memory_read` | 完整读取——字段与 Claude Code 官方 `project_memory_read` 一致（`content?`、`local_file?`、`size_bytes`、`updated_at`、`truncated`） |
| `memory_list` | 双域最近记忆列表（新→旧） |

工具描述内置主动保存指引——偏好、决策、关键数字不用吩咐就存，密钥永不存。

**写入规则（移植自 Claude Code / Gemini CLI 实践）：**
- **强证据门槛**——存前自问"一个月后还有用吗？"，不确定就跳过（噪音比缺口更贵）
- **去重更新**——同主题再存 → 原地更新（内容替换、时间戳刷新），不追加重复
- **日期索引**——每条带 YYYY-MM-DD，注入时模型可推理新旧
- **密钥拒存**——凭据/令牌/密码一律拒绝并明说，覆盖所有写入路径

## 何时记 · 记什么 · 记哪级

**何时记**：偏好/纠正出现（纠正是最高价值记忆）、决策诞生、关键数字/ID 出现、踩坑+解法闭环。**永不记**：密钥、临时状态、代码里直接能读到的、未证实的猜测。

**记哪级**——一句话判定：关于"这个人"还是"这个工程"？

| 记用户级 `~/.dsh/memory` | 记项目级 `<项目根>/.dsh/memory` |
|---|---|
| 个人偏好（我用 pnpm、注释用中文） | 技术决策（用 A 方案，因为 C） |
| 工作习惯（先跑测试再提交） | 项目约定（目录结构、命名、构建命令） |
| 跨项目经验（"这类库都有 X 坑"） | 关键数字/ID（端口、服务器、AppID） |
| 沟通风格 | 一切该随版本库共享给团队的 |

换个项目这条还成立？→ 用户级。只在这里成立？→ 项目级。

## 工作原理

**两个物理隔离的存储域**——用户级 `~/.dsh/memory` + 项目级 `<项目根>/.dsh/memory`——永不混淆。项目根按优先级链自动判定，越明确的信号越优先：

1. `DSH_MEMORY_PROJECT_DIR` 环境变量
2. 向上找已存在的 `.dsh/memory` 标记（支持嵌套子项目）
3. 向上找任意 VCS 根：`.git` / `.svn` / `.hg`
4. 宿主 workspace 注册表（DSH 官方项目注册表）
5. 当前目录兜底——无 VCS 项目也拥有自己的作用域

**存储布局**

```
~/.dsh/memory/                      <- 用户级（个人，跨项目）
|-- MEMORY.md                       <- 护栏索引，新→旧
|-- memories/20261004-181500-prefer-pnpm.md
<项目根>/.dsh/memory/               <- 项目级（团队共享，随版本库提交）
```

**注入**发生在会话启动时（`ctx.systemPrompt`）：user 域记忆恒注入；项目根级恒注入；带路径标签的按"命中工作目录链 **或 触碰目录链**"注入（见上方触碰激活）；未触碰的计数进提示行；注入另有 25 条上限叠在域级护栏之上。

## 验证

```sh
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # 64 项测试，0 类型错误
```

单元 + 对官方类型真实编译 + 运行时冒烟（真实 `defineTool`，save → search → read → list 端到端）+ 真实 cordis 激活守卫；CI 跑 Ubuntu **和** Windows。

与 DSH 官方 MCP 记忆方案完全共存——按工作流任选，或两者同用。MIT 协议，与 DeepSeek、Anthropic 无关联。

# dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit

**模型写到输出上限被截断时，插件替你按「继续」。**

**简体中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 宿主侧插件：监听 `turn/end` 的 `max-tokens` 结束原因，通过
`agent.followup()` 发一条普通的下一个 turn 提示词，并受每会话 burst 上限、
最小间隔和总开关约束。没有客户端半部，不碰 React slot，不依赖任何 UI 快照字段。

> **English.** A host-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that presses "continue" for you
> when the model stops because it exhausted its output-token budget. It watches
> `turn/end` for `reason.kind === 'max-tokens'` and issues an ordinary next-turn
> follow-up through `agent.followup()`, gated by a per-session burst cap, a
> minimum interval, and an opt-out. No client half, no UI snapshot dependency,
> 61 tests on bare `node`.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)
![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-61%20passing-brightgreen)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-informational)

---

## 目录

- [它解决什么](#它解决什么)
- [安装](#安装)
- [配置](#配置)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
  - [1. 检测：只听宿主侧事件](#1-检测只听宿主侧事件)
  - [2. 发送时机：为什么不能直接在回调里发](#2-发送时机为什么不能直接在回调里发)
  - [3. 消息身份：为什么不用 user](#3-消息身份为什么不用-user)
- [安全设计](#安全设计)
- [测试](#测试)
- [已知限制](#已知限制)
- [与 harness 原生的关系](#与-harness-原生的关系)
- [故障排查](#故障排查)
- [开发](#开发)
- [License](#license)

## 它解决什么

dsh 原生**不会**自动续写。一个 turn 以 `max-tokens` 结束时，harness 把会话停住，
UI 显示「回答被截断…发送"继续"可让模型接着输出」。这是有意设计——等人来决定要不要
接着写。

如果你嫌每次截断都要手打两个字，这个插件就是把那两个字自动化。

自动续写**不冒充人类输入**：它以插件身份进入对话，在聊天界面渲染成一条
「插件状态更新」，写明是哪条通知触发了这一轮。一条链完整可审计。

## 安装

本插件是一个标准的 dsh bundle，通过 profile 的 `package.json` 挂载。

### 从 npm 安装

在 profile 的 `package.json`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json`）里加依赖，并加进
`bundles`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "^0.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录里装依赖，重启 dsh：

```bash
pnpm install
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 会通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动挂进 patch 列表，不需要手写那条
`- insert:`。

### 从源码安装

只有要改插件本身时才需要。先 clone 并装好它自己的依赖：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit.git
cd dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit
npm install --ignore-scripts
```

用 npm 而非 pnpm：pnpm 在部分沙箱环境下建不出 junction，会把顶层 `node_modules`
落成实体目录，导致 `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` 不可达。

再把 profile 的依赖指向本地路径：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
  }
}
```

`pnpm install`，重启 dsh。

### 卸载

删掉依赖和 `bundles` 里那一行，再 `pnpm install`。没有残留状态。

> 本插件**不是** `required` bundle：组合失败不会写启动日志。装完请确认 Plugins
> 页面能看到 `continue-on-limit` 这一项。

## 配置

三个字段全部是 `.volatile()`：在 Plugins 页面改了**不重载 fiber**，
`enabled: false` 中途就能掐断一条正在跑的链。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 总开关 |
| `continueText` | string (1–200) | `继续` | 发什么文字 |
| `maxConsecutive` | integer (0–16) | `3` | 单会话一条截断链最多自动续写几次；`0` = 无上限 |
| `minIntervalMs` | integer (0–600000) | `1500` | 两次续写的最小间隔，防死循环 |

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的默认值：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: continue-on-limit
      name: 'dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit'
      config:
        enabled: true
        continueText: '继续'
        maxConsecutive: 3
        minIntervalMs: 1500
```

## 工作原理

### 1. 检测：只听宿主侧事件

宿主侧单一数据源，和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver` 用的是同一条路：

```js
ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => {
  if (event.type !== 'turn/end') return;
  const agent = ctx.agents.get(session.id);
  if (agent === void 0 || agent.session !== session) return;
  if (event.data.reason.kind !== 'max-tokens') return;
  // ...
});
```

`turn/end` 的 payload 就是 `{ turn, reason }`，`reason` 是 `TurnEndReason`，
截断标记直接可读。

**刻意没有用的两条路：**

- `agent/turn-stopping`——payload 是 `{ agent, turn, signal }`，**没有 reason**，
  拿不到截断信息，只能盲发。
- 客户端 `SessionSnapshot`——字段是固定的 14 个，其中**没有** `queue`、`pending`、
  `nodes`（真实字段叫 `pendingSubmissions`）。按名字猜字段会在每次快照更新时抛
  `TypeError`；即便加了 `?.`，候选集也永远是空集，检测分支永远进不去——
  表现为「装得上、起得来、功能不触发」。

### 2. 发送时机：为什么不能直接在回调里发

`turn/end` 是从 `Session.append` **内部**广播出来的，而 `append` 在广播期间把重入
闸门打开：

```js
if (entry?.appending) throw new Error("session append cannot reenter while another append is being published");
// ...callbacks 同步运行...
finally { entry.appending = false; }   // 回调返回后才复位
```

`Agent.followup()` 本身就要 append（它得写一条 inbox splice 记录），所以从回调里
**同步**调用必然抛错：

```text
Error: session append cannot reenter while another append is being published
    at Session.append        (dsh-session)
    at ReactLoopInbox.mutate (dsh-agent-loop)
    at ReactLoopInbox.splice
```

所以发送推迟到 agent 真正 idle 之后：

```js
state.pending = true;
void sendContinuation(...);   // 内部 await agent.whenIdle() 之后才 followup
```

**为什么必须等 idle，而不是随便推迟一个 microtask？** 因为 `wakeDriver()` 只在
`phase.kind === 'idle'` 时才启动新驱动：

```js
wakeDriver(wakeAfterAbort = false) {
  if (this.phase.kind !== "idle") { /* 只有 maintenance / abort 才记 wakeRequested */ return; }
  this.setPhase({ kind: "running", ... });   // 真正开下一轮
}
```

而驱动循环在 `append("turn/end")` 之后立刻检查
`if (!this.inbox.hasPending) return false`。消息若晚于这个检查才进 inbox，驱动已经
收工，此时 `wakeDriver` 在 `running` 状态下**不会**记 `wakeRequested`，消息就躺在
inbox 里没人处理。`await agent.whenIdle()` 之后 phase 必为 `idle`，`followup()`
才会真正开出下一轮。

`state.pending` 补的就是这段窗口：发送被推迟期间 `lastTurn` 还没写，第二个
`turn/end` 会重复调度，`pending` 是那道预留，发送落定后清除。

### 3. 消息身份：为什么不用 user

`Agent.followup()` 在调用方不传 `source` 时会自己盖一个 `{ kind: 'user' }`，
而 harness 把 `user` 当作**人的授权**。自动续写冒充人，approval / ask-user
这类流程会误以为真有人在场。

所以插件发的消息 `source.kind` 是 `cordis-host-runner`——harness 在
`MessageSourceMap` 里给宿主侧自动行为预留的 source 类型：

```ts
'cordis-host-runner': { kind: 'cordis-host-runner'; };
```

聊天界面会以「插件触发」的样式渲染。一条链完整可审计。

消息本体是本地构造的，没有 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`：
`createUserMessage()` 就是 `createMessage({ ...input, role: 'user' })`，而
`brandString()` 在运行时是恒等函数（文档明确写了 branded id 无 tag、无 prototype、
无 registry），所以本地铸造的 id 完全等价。这样插件的依赖表里只剩 schema 一个，
整包可以用裸 `node --test` 跑，不需要启动 harness、不需要 mock 快照。

## 安全设计

### 三道闸

`maxConsecutive` 是主闸。`3` 是刻意的默认值：够写完一个长回答，又不至于让一个反复
溢出的模型一路烧到上下文塞满。`0` 是显式的「无上限」，属于危险选项。

`minIntervalMs` 是死循环兜底，不是节奏控制——真实模型回复本来就比它慢得多。

### 隐式保护

- inbox 里已有用户排队消息时，**让用户的先跑**（`nextTurn` / `nextStep` 非空即跳过）
- 同一个 turn 不重复续写；发送排队期间（`pending`）也不重复调度
- 非 `max-tokens` 的 turn end 一律不动，且会重置 burst 计数
- `followup()` 抛错只写日志，不往 `session/event` 回调里冒泡；发送本身推迟到
  agent idle 之后（见上文）

### 配置值不会被敲错一个数就失控

`.volatile()` 字段是从 Plugins 页面**直接写进 reference cell** 的，不走加载器的
`Config` 校验。也就是说 schema 只守住了初始组合那一次，运行期改值无人把关。

如果不加防护，在设置页把 `maxConsecutive` 敲成 `-1` 就能让它失效：
`decide()` 里 `if (maxConsecutive > 0 && ...)` 直接短路，**上限静默变成无限制**。
`minIntervalMs: -1` 同理让冷却失效。

所以 `readSettings()` 对每个字段做了类型检查 + 钳制（`LIMITS` 和 schema 共用同一份
边界常量）：

| 输入 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `maxConsecutive: -1` / `99` / `2.5` / `'lots'` | 回落到默认 `3` |
| `maxConsecutive: 0` | 保留 `0`（显式的"无上限"是刻意选项） |
| `minIntervalMs: -50` / `7000000` | 回落到默认 `1500` |
| `continueText: 42` / `'   '` | 回落到默认 `'继续'` |
| `continueText: 'x'.repeat(400)` | 截到 200 |
| `continueText: '  trim me  '` | 去空白 → `'trim me'` |
| `enabled: 'nope'` | 回落到默认 `true` |

关键点是**负数回落到默认值，而不是回落到 `0`**。`0` 是"关掉这道闸"，一个误输的
负数不该有这个权力。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
# tests 61, pass 61, fail 0
```

61 个用例分三层：

| 文件 | 用例 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|---|
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 17 | 纯决策逻辑，直接喂普通对象，**不 import 任何 Cordis**。burst 上限、冷却、同 turn 去重、非截断 reason、disabled 不改状态…… |
| `test/index.test.mjs` | 28 | 用 mock ctx 驱动真实的 `apply()`，断言 `agent.followup()` 收到的消息形状、冻结性、日志路径、异常边界、session 回收，以及**重入约束**（mock 在 dispatch 窗口内让 `followup` 抛错，断言窗口内零发送、idle 后恰好一次） |
| `test/contract.test.mjs` | 16 | **加载契约**，不测行为，只测"装上会不会炸"。复刻加载器 `jc()` 的逐字逻辑 |

`contract.test.mjs` 断言的具体内容：module graph 能解析、`name` / `inject` /
`Config` / `apply` 都在且类型对、`validate(undefined)` 与 `validate({})` 都不报
`issues`、返回值不是 promise、`Config["~standard"]` 存在、`package.json` 的
`main` / `dsh.bundle.patch` / `files` 全指向真实文件、依赖目录真实可读，以及
import + compose 循环 25 次都稳定。

> `test` 脚本带 `--test-isolation=none`，因为 DSH 的文件沙箱禁止
> `child_process.spawn`，而 `node --test` 默认要给每个测试文件起子进程。
> 在普通环境里用 `node --test` 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只认 `max-tokens`。** `aborted` / `error` / `blocked` / `interrupted` /
  `forked` 一律不动。它们要么是模型自己停的，要么是被人停的，发「继续」救不回来。
- **计数器是内存态。** 进程重启会清零，一条跨重启的链会被当成新链。
- **429 / 配额耗尽不在范围内。** 那是另一个问题域。
- **不判断模型是否真的写完了。** 它只是替你按键。如果模型陷入循环复读，
  `maxConsecutive` 会兜住轮数，但代价还是要你自己看日志确认。
- **不感知子代理。** `ctx.agents.get()` 对子代理会话同样返回 agent，所以子代理的
  截断也会被续写，共享同一套 burst 上限。如果只想管主会话，把 `maxConsecutive`
  调小或直接 `enabled: false`。

## 与 harness 原生的关系

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver` 在 `turn/end` 为 `max-tokens` 时会 disarm
（取消授权）：goal 语义下，被截断意味着这轮没交付完成，不该自动进下一轮。

本插件不改变任何既有行为，只是补一条 follow-up。两者关注的层次不同：
goal driver 决定「要不要开下一轮」，本插件只处理「这一轮没写完」。可以共存。

## 故障排查

**装完没反应。** 本插件不是 `required` bundle，组合失败不会写启动日志。先在
Plugins 页面确认 `continue-on-limit` 出现，再看 `ctx.logger` 有没有
`continue-on-limit:` 开头的行。

**截断了但没续写。** 依次检查：`enabled` 是否为 `true`；`maxConsecutive` 是否已到顶
（到顶会写一条 warn）；inbox 里是否有排队的人类消息（会让给人类）。

**装完 dsh 启动就崩，`import` 阶段报错。** 有一个真实踩过的坑：**npm 的
`node_modules` 内容和 npm 缓存之间存在引用关系，删掉缓存会把装好的包打成坏的
重解析点**——目录还在，`stat` 报 `size=0`，`readdir` 直接 `ENOENT`。插件本身完全
没坏，但 dsh 一启动 `import` 就崩。

所以：装好之后**不要删 npm 缓存**。要清理就删掉 `node_modules` 重新
`npm install`。装完先跑一次 `npm test`，`contract.test.mjs` 会逐个检查每个依赖
目录及其 `package.json` 是否真实可读，并重复 import 25 次确认稳定。

**想要零依赖版本。** 删掉 `Config` 导出即可：加载器对没有 `Config` 的插件是
`if (!e.Config) return n` 直接放行。代价是失去设置页和实时切换。

## 开发

```bash
npm install --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

代码结构：

```text
lib/policy.js   纯决策逻辑，零框架依赖 —— 什么时候该发
lib/index.js    接线 —— 读事件、找 agent、发消息
cordis.patch.yml 组合声明
```

把决策逻辑剥到无框架依赖的 `policy.js` 里，是为了让「什么时候该发」这条主链路能被
裸 node 直接验证，不需要启动 harness、不需要 mock 快照。这是整个包最容易出错、
也最难在集成环境里观察的一层。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 Rina

# dsh-opencode-free-model

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/artorias-zj/dsh-opencode-free-model)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts the **OpenCode Zen free model lane**
(`opencode.ai/zen/v1/*`) into your model picker with **no API key**.

It is a Host-only cordis plugin. It registers two provider routes on the `llm`
service, decodes all three wire protocols the lane speaks (Chat Completions /
Responses / Messages) into the harness `StreamChunk` protocol, and uses a
background probe to decide which models get advertised.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:artorias-zj/dsh-opencode-free-model
```

Restart DSH afterwards and an **OpenCode Free** group appears in the model
picker.

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| 🔑 **No key** | The lane is keyed by a pooled credential, `Authorization: Bearer public`. The plugin holds no secret of yours, and stores none. |
| 🔀 **Three wire protocols** | `muse-spark-*` goes to `/zen/v1/responses`, `union-alpha` to `/zen/v1/messages`, everything else to `/zen/v1/chat/completions`; all three SSE dialects decode into one host block protocol. (Routing is by model id, so a model the upstream withdraws simply stops being advertised — `union-alpha` is in that state today; the mapping itself still stands.) |
| 🧭 **Protocol decided by shape** | The gateway lies in `Content-Type` (a JSON header over an SSE body is a real production incident). The verdict comes from the body's own shape, and the bytes spent sniffing it are replayed — not one token is buffered. |
| 🖐 **The fingerprint quartet** | The free tier requires the request body to declare the tool names `bash/glob/grep/read`, or it answers 403 `FreeTierError`. A missing slot is filled by promoting a real tool that can answer for it (`pwsh`→`bash` on Windows) before it is faked, and the response side restores the caller's own spelling. |
| 🧷 **Stable sessions** | One conversation maps to one stable `ses_…`. Minting a fresh session per request gets you rate-limited by the gateway's per-session accounting (429). |
| 🔍 **Availability probing** | A background probe with concurrency 2 classifies every model as `available / region-blocked / unavailable / throttled / unknown`. An egress change re-probes immediately; an all-429 round backs off exponentially; an all-refused round does not empty the picker; 5xx never demotes a model. |
| 🌍 **Region routing** | Egress-sensitive models (`muse-spark-*`) that the gateway refuses here move to the `opencode-free-model-region` route; `exposeRegionModels: false` hides it. |
| ♻️ **Reasoning-cutoff continuation** | A turn cut off with reasoning and nothing visible — no text, no tool call, no finish token — is continued once from its checkpoint, with tools forced off. |
| 🎚 **Effort levels are real budgets** | The lane ignores `reasoning_effort` and every `thinking.*` spelling; the only control it honours is `max_tokens`. So `light/balanced/deep` map to output budgets, and a model that cannot stop thinking (`canDisableThinking: false`) has every rung doubled, since thinking and the answer share one ceiling. |

## Routes

| Route id | Picker group | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `opencode-free-model` | OpenCode Free | Free models usable from this egress |
| `opencode-free-model-region` | OpenCode Free · region-limited | Models refused by region, advertised per probe result |

The client hides a group with no models, so a VPN user sees one group and a user
without sees the second one labelled with the reason.

**Models inside a group are sorted alphabetically by display name** (case-folded,
digits in natural order: `V2.6` before `V2.10`), with the id breaking ties, so the
order is total and does not jump between refreshes. The sort lives in
`listModels()` — the kernel maps its return order straight into the browser
catalog and the settings client does not reorder, so that is the only place that
decides what is on screen. It sorts on `name` rather than `id`, because `name` is
the string in front of the user (ordering by id would file `DeepSeek V4 Flash`
under `d`).

## Configuration

Configuration comes from the bundle patch's `config` key. It applies on **every**
mount, so a key written there always wins over a default; a key it omits falls
back to the default instead of sticking from a previous mount. Only runtime
bookkeeping (`runtime.json`) is written to disk.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: opencode-free-model
      name: 'dsh-opencode-free-model'
      config:
        enabled: true              # master switch; false advertises nothing and fails calls with CONFIG_DISABLED
        exposeRegionModels: true   # advertise region-limited models on the second route
        probeIntervalMinutes: 15   # background re-probe period, in minutes (>= 1)
        defaultMaxTokens: 32768    # per-turn output ceiling (further lowered by the model's own capacity)
        streamRecovery: true       # allow one reasoning-checkpoint continuation
        # wireOverrides:           # pin a model to a wire if the upstream moves it
        #   some-model-free: chat
        # baseUrl: https://opencode.ai
```

A key with the wrong shape is ignored with a warning rather than failing the
plugin — a plugin that refuses to load is far worse than one running with a
default.

The environment variable `OPENCODE_FREE_MODEL_BASE` overrides the upstream root
(`config.baseUrl` takes precedence).

## Install

```powershell
# from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:artorias-zj/dsh-opencode-free-model

# or from a local clone / development directory
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\Project\DSH\dsh-opencode-free-model

# verify: dump-config should contain exactly one opencode-free-model row
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config
```

The CLI writes the dependency and the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry into the
profile's `package.json`; `cordis.patch.yml` injects the loader row (`name` must
be the **bare** package name, or a client half cannot resolve the package root —
this plugin is Host-only and declares no `dsh.client`, but the rule still governs
the loader row).

Restart DSH once after installing: host plugin code is cached by URL, so toggling
the loader entry re-runs `apply()` from the cached module rather than reloading
modules you changed on disk.

## Compatibility & permissions

| | |
|---|---|
| **Profiles** | Any profile that mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` — verified on `desktop` and `web`. Host half only: no `dsh.client` declaration, no browser code. |
| **Platform** | Anywhere Node runs. Pure ESM, no native modules, no build step, no runtime dependencies. |
| **Runtime** | Node `^22.15.0 || >=24.0.0` (the `engines.node` range). |
| **DSH version** | Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately *not* declared: only that one line has actually been exercised, and a SemVer range would claim more than has been verified. |
| **Credentials** | None. The lane is a public key-free allowance, so the plugin holds no secret and reads none — it never touches the credential service. |
| **Registers** | Two `llm` provider routes. It adds no tools, no commands, no slash commands, no keyboard shortcuts and no client UI. |
| **Writes** | Only under `$DSH_HOME/opencode-free-model/` — `runtime.json`, `catalog.json`, `availability.json`, each written atomically. Nothing outside that directory. |
| **Reads** | Your own attached images, and only to inline one into a request the model is already answering (through the optional `attachments` service; if it is absent, image blocks fall back to the text projection the runtime already performs). |
| **Outbound hosts** | `opencode.ai` — inference and model listing, the only destination your prompts reach — plus `api.ipify.org` / `ipinfo.io` / `ipapi.co`, which are read once to learn this machine's public IP and country so the plugin knows whether a re-probe is needed. Details in [Upstream](#upstream). |
| **Telemetry** | None. Nothing is reported anywhere except the request itself. |
| **Category** | Models & Reasoning. |

## What it looks like

The picker groups, exactly as the plugin advertises them (alphabetical, as
described under [Routes](#routes)):

```
OpenCode Free                    9 models
  Fledge Alpha Free
  Jev 1.13
  Ling 3.1 Flash Free
  Longcat 2.5 Preview Free
  MiMo V2.5
  MiMo V2.6 Flash
  Nemotron 3 Ultra
  Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
  Space Bunny

OpenCode Free · region-limited   2 models
  Muse Spark 1.2
  Muse Spark 1.3
```

And one real streamed turn, captured against the live lane — note the disjoint
token accounting:

```
finish {"kind":"stop"}
usage  {"inputTokens":34,"outputTokens":11,"totalTokens":237,"cacheReadTokens":192,"reasoningTokens":8}
tools  0
answer "OK"
```

`inputTokens` is uncached input only — `34 = 226 prompt − 192 cached` — which is
what the harness expects and what the provider's raw `prompt_tokens` does not
give you.

## Layout

```
dsh-opencode-free-model/
├── cordis.patch.yml   the loader injection row
├── package.json       dsh.bundle.patch declaration (with the files allow-list)
├── icon.svg
├── LICENSE
├── README.md          this file
├── README.zh.md       Chinese
└── lib/               the plugin, 13 modules
    index.js     Host half: apply, registration, catalog refresh, probe loop, membership, config merge
    adapter.js   OcFreeModelAdapter: providerInfo/listModels/resolveModel/prepareCall/stream
    upstream.js  upstream vocabulary: base URL, three endpoints, fingerprint quartet, session/request ids, headers
    http.js      outbound HTTP: deadlines, byte sniffing, SSE framing, failure classification
    stream.js    three-wire SSE -> host StreamChunk (block allocation, usage accounting, terminal frames, error frames)
    messages.js  tool-pairing repair + three-wire message projection
    effort.js    effort levels -> output budgets
    recovery.js  checkpoint-continuation policy
    catalog.js   capability baseline + free-lane filter + listing parser + membership split
    probe.js     availability probing (concurrency 2, failure classification, egress detection)
    store.js     JsonStore (atomic writes, coalesced writes, corrupt files preserved)
    channel.js   single-producer / single-consumer async channel
    kernel.js    the only seam allowed to import @deepseek-ai/* (attribution UA)
```

`kernel.js` is the only file that names `@deepseek-ai/*`; every other module
depends on the structural `ctx` contract alone, so the plugin pins no kernel
version and the rule is checkable with one grep.

## Upstream

One source, and it is not a relay: `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/*`.

| Purpose | Target | Credential |
|---|---|---|
| Inference | `POST …/zen/v1/chat/completions`, `…/responses`, `…/messages` (per model) | `Authorization: Bearer public` — a public, key-free allowance; the plugin holds no user secret |
| Model listing | `GET …/zen/v1/models` | same |
| Egress IP | `api.ipify.org` / `ipinfo.io` / `ipapi.co` (reads back this machine's public IP and country code, only to decide whether a re-probe is needed) | none |

## Known limitations

- **`GenerateOptions` sampling is `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `stop` only**, and
  the only one the lane honours is the output ceiling — so `reasoningEffort`
  means "budget rung" here, not "thinking intensity".
- **An effort level is a budget**: a lower rung shortens the thinking *and* the
  answer, because the lane gives you one shared ceiling and nothing else.
- **Region verdicts require probing**: the gateway does not disclose which models
  your egress may use, so the plugin has to ask.
- **The probe period is read at mount time**: changing `probeIntervalMinutes`
  needs a plugin reload to take effect.

## License

MIT — see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

The wire-protocol facts (the pooled key-free credential, the client fingerprint
headers, the per-model endpoint split, the free-tier tool-fingerprint gate, the
per-session quota accounting, and the regional gate) come from the MIT-licensed
reference implementation `dsh-our-free-model` (Copyright © 2026 zouyuxuan122) and
the `zen-gate` project. Both copyright notices are carried in `LICENSE`, which is
kept as unmodified MIT text so the license is machine-detectable.

DSH run, lease, receipt, retrieval, Deep inputs/artifacts/budgets/reports, post-completion memory-finalization, and embedding state inside that database

Legacy history compatibility under DSH's native write lease: exact rejected v3 file or validated new v3 generation from retained v0, identical .bak, disposable validation artifacts, and automatic deletion of confirmed identity-mismatched native logs
Opt-in Lisp scratch, input snapshots, verified compiled bundle cache, durable operation journal, and approved file changes with host backups
Project files through owned native tools; private execution outbox beside the configured Kiokuko database

externalServices: GitHub or skills.sh for optional Skill discovery and source retrieval
User-configured embedding endpoint when remote embeddings are enabled
DSH-configured model providers for explicitly started Deep planning and its budgeted memory extraction
The explicitly selected DSH model provider for a user-started Diff review without tools
DSH-configured model provider for automatic memory review (active by default, up to 12 worker dispatches per project per UTC day), ordinary finalization and configured memory evolution

Configured TypeSafe fixed endpoint or explicit Nimble HTTPS/loopback endpoint for automatic task/Skill/draft decisions, projected memory reuse after a synthetic readiness probe, and Lisp; no redirects, retries or provider substitution; exact roles.check no-tool fallback for complete draft review

Explicit Laya-CoreML Unix socket for local finite decisions using the existing v1 worker or optional strict operations; no subprocess client, automatic worker startup, model downloads or provider substitution

DSH-configured admitted provider/model for default-active source-backed index reasoning: up to 8 worker dispatches per workspace per UTC day; no retrieval-time generation or automatic resend of uncertain dispatches
User-configured AI API endpoints and vendored provider OAuth flows through Kiokuko Models
credentials: Optional user-provided GitHub or embedding credentials; never bundled or persisted by the plugin

TYPESAFE_API_KEY resolved per explicit call; optional DSH-managed set/unset via /kioku-typesafe-key, inherited environment precedence, no worker or Kiokuko storage exposure; input visible while typing

failureBoundaries: Repository identity, run identity, lease, revision, and integrity mismatches fail closed

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Kiokuko(記憶庫) DeepSeek Harness Plugin
[日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md)

Kiokuko adds memory, planning, verification, and observability to
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Automatic memory review saves or updates useful project candidates after eight completed human turns, even while a chat remains open. It is active by default and uses the session model. Check `/kioku-memory-review status` or exclude a conversation with `/kioku-memory-review exclude session`. [Settings, costs and recovery](docs/auto-memory-review.md).

Inspect sources and corrections with `/kioku-memory explain ENTRY_ID`; explicitly forget a memory with `/kioku-memory forget ENTRY_ID --revision N`. [Evidence, explanations and forgetting](docs/memory-evidence.md).

## Features

- **Kiokuko Models** — Connect and authenticate from Web Settings or `/kiokuko model`, independently of native Models settings. Includes Infron Standard/Flex. [Setup and shared credentials](docs/kiokuko-models.md)
- **Execution modes** — Choose normal execution or 役小角(enno-oduno) for role-based planning and verification. [Details](docs/model-selection.md)
- **Project memory** — Retrieve useful project knowledge for later work. [Concepts](docs/concepts.md)
- **Deep planning** — Run bounded, read-only investigation with four roles. [Usage](docs/deep-planning.md)
- **DSH subagents** — The standard preset provides `subagent` and `subagent_fork`; native children do not repeat Kiokuko's execution-mode choice. [Configuration](docs/dsh-plugin.md#subagents)
- **Continuity** — Disabled by default. Set `continuity.mode: active` to summarize recent execution evidence for the model. [Setup](docs/continuity.md)
- **Memory evolution** — Turn completed work into reusable episode and lesson candidates. [Settings](docs/memory-evolution.md)
- **Verified automatic Global memory** — Three independent, host-observed successful applications can create a scoped `source_verified` Global memory. [Conditions and opt-out](docs/auto-globalization.md)
- **AgenticReplay** — Record model/tool activity and export it as HTML. [Settings and commands](docs/agenticreplay-recording.md)
- **Japanese output** — Give supported models a bundled Skill for natural Japanese. [Details](docs/japanese-output.md)

Tool exposure defaults to `auto`: task type and current phase determine the Kiokuko model tools shown. Native tools stay available; `full` is an explicit compatibility override. See [tool exposure](docs/tool-exposure.md).

## Install and use

Runtime compatibility target: **DSH 0.1.7-rc.2**. Native request paths, legacy session migration, and a packed Web lifecycle pass locally ([verification scope](docs/dsh-plugin.md#compatibility)).

Requires Node.js **24.16.0+** and pnpm.
Run these commands from the DSH source directory to install the published npm package and start:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add kiokuko-dsh
pnpm dsh web
```

If you use a globally installed `dsh` CLI, omit `pnpm` from the commands.
Enter your task normally; no Kiokuko setup command is needed.
For GitHub/local installation, see the [plugin guide](docs/dsh-plugin.md).

## Update

Finish active tasks and stop DSH before updating. Update the npm-installed plugin:

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update kiokuko-dsh --latest
pnpm dsh web
```

To update a release published within the last 24 hours, disable pnpm 11's default
[`minimumReleaseAge`](https://pnpm.io/settings/dependency-resolution#minimumreleaseage)
check for Kiokuko and its dependencies. Confirm that the second command prints `0`,
then update:

```bash
pnpm config set --location=global --json minimumReleaseAge 0
pnpm config get minimumReleaseAge
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update kiokuko-dsh --latest
```

This setting persists globally and disables the release-age check for future pnpm
installs and updates as well. Restart DSH after the update succeeds.

At startup, all seventeen bundled Skills (including Japanese output) and their references are synchronized to `~/.agents/skills/`. Missing files are created and managed copies are updated; unmanaged files are preserved. Other agents must reload their Skill catalog.

These are the full-package defaults. The [configured core and optional modules](docs/core-modules.md) build ships only selected resources; core alone provides conversation, research, writing and project memory without Enno/Lisp runtimes.

Startup also refreshes an existing Kiokuko managed block in the startup directory’s `AGENTS.md`, preserving your other instructions. Restart DSH after updating the package. See [setup and verification](docs/dsh-plugin.md#what-setup-updates-and-when) for another workspace or stale copies; `kiokuko use` is not the DSH setup command.

The `agenticreplay` distribution uses `>=0.1.0 <1.0.0`, so future patch and minor releases
can be installed by an explicit dependency update without changing the range.
Lockfiles retain the tested versions until updated. Restart DSH afterward.
When upgrading from OrcaReplay, rename explicit `orca` settings to `agenticReplay`;
saved session choices survive and legacy traces are retained but not imported.
[Update details](docs/dsh-plugin.md#update) · [Recording upgrade](docs/agenticreplay-recording.md#upgrade-from-orcareplay)

If existing chats fail with an unknown `kiokuko/` event, see [history repair](docs/session-history-repair.md).

If Kiokuko fails to load after a DSH update, see [startup recovery](docs/dsh-plugin.md#startup-failure-after-a-dsh-update) for profile-specific update and reinstall commands. Keep session logs and the Kiokuko database; reinstallation cannot fix every API incompatibility.

[Documentation](docs/README.md) · [Permissions](PERMISSIONS.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)
## Optional Common Lisp tools

Install SBCL first:

- macOS: `brew install sbcl`
- Debian / Ubuntu: `sudo apt install sbcl`
- Arch Linux: `sudo pacman -S sbcl`

Add this to the `kiokuko-dsh` row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`
(keep other `config` values), then reload the plugin. Each implementation task
shows its Goal, items and observable checks before asking whether to use Lisp.
The choice belongs to that task and scope; a new task asks again.
You can also enable it with `/kioku-lisp enable`.
Check the loaded configuration with `dsh --profile web --dump-config`.

```yaml
- id: kiokuko-dsh
  config:
    lisp:
      enabled: true
      sbclPath: sbcl
```

The default development mode does not require Bubblewrap. The explicit protected compatibility mode does on Linux.
Choose “使う” to use Lisp, “使わない” to use ordinary tools, or “取消・作業を保持” to cancel while preserving prepared work. Closing the question leaves implementation pending. Lisp choice and normal/Enno selection are separate. A failed Lisp startup remains a recoverable blocker until the selected route works or you explicitly change it.
Ordinary edits and tests run without further confirmation after that choice. Source/data deletion and existing durable user database mutation require a concrete review. Lisp and ordinary tools coexist. Completion requires current item evidence and a fresh final check through the user’s entry point. See [Goal-driven coding](docs/coding-workflow.md) and [owned execution, receipts and memory reuse](docs/owned-execution.md).
See [setup, APIs, limits and recovery](docs/lisp.md).
Persistent Lisp can optionally inspect parser-backed disk snapshots and read-only
LSP results through `kioku.code`. The provider must advertise V1; published
`dsh-lsp-server` v0.1.12 does not. See the [local provider prerequisite](patches/code-intelligence/README.md) and [API and budgets](docs/lisp.md#read-only-code-intelligence).

## Typed decisions (Jev / Laya / Nimble)

Optional [automatic model selection](docs/model-selection.md#automatic-model-selection) chooses a validated `openai-codex` model and reasoning effort for a new normal task. It defaults to `modelAutoMode.mode: off`; `/kioku-model-auto on | observe | off | status` changes only the current session. `observe` measures a proposal without changing the model. It requires a ready Jev or Laya backend, dsh-codex, native model metadata and a token meter. Failed or unavailable classification keeps the current model; manual model selection takes priority.

[Answer review](docs/answer-review.md) is enabled by default on the full plugin and modular core. It evaluates an already displayed normal answer using the configured Jev, Laya or Nimble provider and may ask the same main model to reconsider once. The defaults are:

```yaml
answerReview:
  mode: auto
  budgetMs: 5000
```

Set `answerReview.mode: off` to disable it. It inherits `typedDecisions`, adds evaluation inference (and at most one main-model turn), and does not delay the first answer. If the selected provider is unavailable, review is skipped and the original answer is preserved; no other provider is substituted. Laya v1 findings are unverified suggestions because worker-side truncation cannot be checked. `/kioku-decisions status` reports progress and skip reasons; it does not certify correctness.


Jev is the default. Switch in DSH's command input without editing configuration or restarting DSH:

```text
/kioku-decisions use jev
/kioku-decisions use laya
/kioku-decisions use nimble
/kioku-decisions use default
```

Laya connects directly to the existing worker started by `start-laya`; no worker replacement or fingerprint setup is needed. Jev needs a TypeSafe key; Nimble needs an endpoint and model configured first. A successful probe saves the selection for this project and applies it to new requests. It survives restarts and preserves in-flight request bindings. `use default` restores the plugin configuration.

Set the API key in DSH's `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` if set), or use `/kioku-typesafe-key YOUR_KEY`. Keep any existing entries:

```yaml
version: 1
refs:
  TYPESAFE_API_KEY: YOUR_KEY
```

If creating the YAML file yourself, run `chmod 600 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (use `$DSH_HOME` if set).

In the DSH command UI, check the key and test the connection:

```text
/kioku-typesafe-key status
/kioku-decisions probe
/kioku-decisions status
```

`probe` sends a synthetic API request; `status` does not. `/kioku-typesafe-key clear` removes the stored key. Key input is visible when using `/kioku-typesafe-key YOUR_KEY`. See [typed decisions](docs/typed-decisions.md) and the [explicit Lisp API](docs/typesafe.md) for more.

Jev remains the default. Nimble and local [Laya-CoreML](docs/laya-coreml.md) are optional alternatives; Laya connects directly to `~/Library/Caches/laya-coreml/worker.sock` using the existing v1 `health`/`predict` protocol. `/kioku-decisions install-laya` reuses a running worker or shows setup instructions.

Use `aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml` for English and other languages. Its 1,024-token input capacity includes the question, options and state; the `-ane` variant allows only 96 tokens. See the [upstream model specifications](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml#available-checkpoints). After the [initial setup](docs/Laya-CoreML-ja.md), use the following commands. Stop any running Laya worker before starting it with the new model; `LAYA_MODEL` also overrides the old default in an existing worker script.

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual
hf download \
  aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml \
  --local-dir ~/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual
LAYA_MODEL="$HOME/.local/share/laya-coreml/multilingual" start-laya
```

## Semantic memory reuse

[Semantic memory reuse](docs/memory-reuse.md) checks existing retrieval candidates
against the current request after a synthetic provider probe succeeds. Embeddings
are optional; `memoryReuse.mode: off` disables this additional selection.

[Memory application and verification](docs/memory-application.md) records dispositions and host-observed regression evidence. Check the current native session with `/kioku-memory-application status` or `/kioku-memory-application status --json`.

### Semantic compaction

ObservationPack (`observationPack: { mode: auto }`) preserves large successful native tool results for two model calls, then replaces them with excerpts and an `observation_read` handle. [Semantic compaction](docs/semantic-compaction.md) evaluates TODO completion boundaries and selectively shortens old tool results before native automatic compaction in normal, Enno and Lisp modes. It defaults to `semanticCompaction: { mode: auto, preemptive: true, budgetMs: 5000 }` and requires a ready typed-decision backend and supported native services. Inspect activation and the last outcome with `/kioku-decisions status`.

Laya compaction separately defaults to `typedDecisions.laya-coreml.compaction.mode: off`. Explicit `shadow` evaluates without changing history; `auto` remains `experimental_not_qualified`. This switch preserves ObservationPack and native summaries. Akinator uses only the verified debug/research/writing range, and optional Skill selection uses up to four complete candidates with at most one model-selected addition. See [Laya settings and evaluation](docs/semantic-compaction.md#local-laya).

For the optional V1 code provider, see [installation and verified platform status](docs/code-intelligence.md).

## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.2.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 名册与私聊：每个 Bot 有自己的像素头像；右侧是它的记忆演化。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc1) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 ## 社区 问题、想法，还有你做出来的 Bot，都欢迎带来。 - **Discord**：[加入 DeepSeekBot 服务器](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - **QQ 群**：在 QQ 中搜索群号 **1125565676** - **使用求助、想法与作品分享**：[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) · [欢迎帖](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1397) - **明确的 Bug 与实施任务**：[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose) - **参与维护**：[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [第一次贡献](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398)，文档、测试和答疑也欢迎。 ## 灵感与致谢 - [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot)：持久 Bot，以及像同事一样沟通和委派工作的产品灵感。 - [Rakazo](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo)：持久 AI 队友、对话与记忆体验参考。 - [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)：同样运行在 DSH 上的另一个 Bot 插件，重心不同，值得一读。 - [deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin](https://github.com/loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin)：Memory Git graph 分支线、提交列表与 diff 呈现参考。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：上游插件宿主。 - [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im)、[dsh-lark-link](https://github.com/amlyczz/dsh-lark-link) 与 [dsh-lark-bridge](https://github.com/imetn/dsh-lark-bridge)：IM 接入基础与可靠性、路由参考。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Client Bundle 中分发的第三方素材见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](packages/client/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ## Star History **BotHarness/DeepSeekBot** 的实时 Star 历史，使用 [Star History 官方嵌入方式](https://www.star-history.com/blog/how-to-use-github-star-history/#how-to-embed-the-chart-in-your-readme)。

## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.2.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 名册与私聊：每个 Bot 有自己的像素头像；右侧是它的记忆演化。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。

# DeepSeekBot [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-deepseekbot.botharness.ai-3D5AFE)](https://deepseekbot.botharness.ai/en/) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BotHarness/BotHarness?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) **The open-source Grok Bot alternative for DeepSeek Harness.** A crew of bots, each with its own identity, persona and memory, working together. [Website](https://deepseekbot.botharness.ai/en/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness) · [Docs](https://botharness.ai) · [中文](#中文)
DeepSeekBot installs into [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as one plugin: a Bot roster, DMs and Groups, Git Memory you can see, delegation, and IM identities of the Bots' own. - **Open-source Grok Bot alternative**, MIT licensed - **Built on DeepSeek Harness**: any model provider you connect in DSH works - **Works with other DSH plugins** in the same Profile - **Lark / Feishu, Slack, Discord and WeChat**: Bots speak under their own identity ## Install **Desktop:** in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, go to **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `deepseekbot`, keep the official npm registry and click **Install**, then **Enable now**. **Bot mode** appears in the sidebar. **CLI:** needs Node 22+ and the DSH 0.2 line from `0.2.0-rc.1`. ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` Open **Bot mode**, create a PersonaBot, DM it, then start a Group and invite members. To use Lark, Slack, Discord or WeChat, connect the app in **Settings → IM bots**, then bind the identity and authorize a group in the Bot's Profile. Accounts start disconnected; you turn each one on. ## Every Bot is a colleague - **Lasting identity:** each PersonaBot keeps its own name, Soul (SOUL.md) and avatar across chats, Sessions and Workspaces. - **Git Memory you can see:** a Bot's memory is a plain Git working tree. Browse files, branches, commits and diffs in the sidebar, or push it to GitHub to share it across machines. - **Groups:** messages keep each Bot's identity, and you @ whoever you need. - **Assignments:** grant a Workspace and a Bot can delegate independent Assignments, each with its own Session and report. - **Their own IM identity:** when mentioned in an authorized group or thread, a Bot replies there under its own identity. - **Schedules:** have a Bot do something every few minutes, every hour or every day; add one in the sidebar or just ask the Bot, and lock it when the Bot shouldn't change it. - **Bot Marketplace:** install a Bot someone shared on the [Bot Marketplace](https://market.botharness.ai), or [share your own](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/blob/main/docs/share-bot.md). - **Update notes:** after an install or update, Bot mode shows what changed, and Bot settings check npm for a newer version. More screenshots and per-version highlights are in the [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness#screenshots). ## Pixel avatars Every Bot's default avatar is generated from its name, and while a Bot works its avatar morphs into the tool it is using. Try it on the [website](https://deepseekbot.botharness.ai/en/#avatar); avatars come from [BotPixel](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotPixel). ## Built on DeepSeek Harness DeepSeekBot runs on DSH's own session management and harness, so any LLM provider you connect in DSH works for your Bots, and it installs alongside other DSH plugins. Some plugins may not be compatible yet; please open an [issue](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/issues) or a PR if you hit one. ## Community - Discord: [discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - QQ group: 1125565676 - Issues: [github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/issues) --- ## 中文 **开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** DeepSeekBot 以一个插件装进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：Bot 名册、私聊与 Group、看得见的 Git Memory、定时任务、Bot 市场、任务委派，以及 Bot 自己的 IM 身份（飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信）。它直接用 DSH 的 Session 管理和 Harness，你在 DSH 里接入的任何模型 provider 都能用，也能和其他 DSH 插件装在一起。 **桌面端**：打开 DeepSeek Harness，点「插件 → 添加插件」，在「包名或地址」里输入 `deepseekbot`，点「安装」，再点「立即启用」。 **命令行**： ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add deepseekbot dsh web ``` 更多截图和各版本亮点见 [GitHub README](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness/blob/main/README.md#screenshots)。 官网：[deepseekbot.botharness.ai](https://deepseekbot.botharness.ai) · 源码：[GitHub](https://github.com/BotHarness/BotHarness) · Discord：[加入](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) · QQ 群：1125565676 --- ## Package notes This product Bundle combines BotHarness Core (`@botharness/core`), Client (`@botharness/ui`), Browser (`@botharness/browser`), Computer (`@botharness/computer`) and the independently versioned, qualified IM Provider (`@botharness/im-provider`, maintained from [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) under its MIT license). The Provider updates with the product, without an independent upstream auto-update. Browser and Computer ship present but gated: each Bot still needs its own Browser/Computer Access, and IM accounts start disconnected until you add app credentials in Settings → IM bots. If an existing Profile enables standalone `@xmanrui/dsh-im` or `@botharness/im-provider` as another Bundle, remove that separate Bundle before enabling DeepSeekBot. Formerly separate `@botharness/browser`, `@botharness/computer`, `@botharness/core` or `@botharness/ui` entries migrate into this Bundle automatically on update. Removing a Bundle keeps its stored account configuration and credentials; revalidate the retained Bot bindings and group authorization afterwards. The Bot Browser runs headless by default; a Host that needs the visible window (one-time Human login) overrides `headless` in a later Patch layer or Settings. MIT © BotHarness
# DeepSeekBot **中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/deepseekbot?color=CB3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) [![官网](https://img.shields.io/badge/官网-deepseekbot.app-3D5AFE)](https://deepseekbot.app) [![MIT 许可](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-加入-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) [![QQ 群：1125565676](https://img.shields.io/badge/QQ-1125565676-12B7F5)](#community) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot?style=flat)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) **DeepSeekBot（DSB）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://deepseekbot.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 DeepSeekBot：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。点击封面即可播放。

DeepSeekBot（简称 **DSB**，是 DeepSeekBot 的缩写，才不是“大啥比”，哼）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端点「插件 → 添加插件」，输入 `deepseekbot@1.2.1`，安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | DeepSeekBot 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://deepseekbot.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://deepseekbot.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 名册与私聊：每个 Bot 有自己的像素头像；右侧是它的记忆演化。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://deepseekbot.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://deepseekbot.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)**（2026-10-12） | 修复部分 DSH 版本装不上的问题；群头像显示成员头像拼图；音频和文件附件可以直接播放、下载。 | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.zh.md#120---2026-10-08)**（2026-10-08） | 可以置顶在桌面的像素**窗口伙伴**；绑定一个应用就能在飞书、Slack、Discord、微信里收发消息；Bot 可以**导入导出**成 zip；Bot 资料页加了横幅和简介。 | | **1.1.0**（2026-10-06） | **定时任务**；每次对话都带上 Bot 的人格和核心记忆；设置里**一键更新**；微信支持语音转文字和图片。 | | **1.0.1**（2026-10-05） | 首个正式版：有身份的 PersonaBots、Git 记忆、群聊、任务委派、像素头像、IM 接入和首版 **Bot 市场**。 | ## DeepSeekBot（DSB）与 DS Bot（ds-bot）：两个项目，不同重心 名字很像，但这是两个独立的开源项目：都运行在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）上，都不是 DeepSeek 公司官方产品。 - **DeepSeekBot（DSB）**，即本仓库，由 BotHarness 维护：让每个 Bot 成为一位能**走出 DSH 窗口**的长期同事。重心是可审阅的 Git 记忆、Bot 自己的飞书 / Slack / Discord / 微信身份、定时任务、任务委派和 Bot 市场。 - **DS Bot**，即 [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（npm `ds-bot`，项目 README 中也写作 DeepSeek Bot）：把 **DSH 本身变成一个 Bot 聊天应用**。重心是由主 Bot「Chief」通过对话带你建好团队、群管理员默认统筹回复以控制 token 消耗，以及按时间、Bot 和模型查看用量。 | | DeepSeekBot（DSB） | DS Bot（ds-bot） | | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | | 仓库 | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | 安装包 | npm [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | 许可 | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | 记忆 | 每个 Bot 一个 Git 工作树：文件、commit、diff，可推到 GitHub 在多台机器共享 | Markdown 记忆，每轮后自动审查；个人与团队两级 | | 多 Bot 协作 | Group 中需要谁就 @ 谁；Assignments 委派独立任务并保留报告 | 主 Bot 管理团队；群管理员默认回复，再按需叫其他 Bot | | DSH 之外 | Bot 以自己的身份进入飞书 / Lark、Slack、Discord、微信 | 提供 GitHub connector | | 其他 | 定时任务、Bot 市场、Bot 导入导出、像素头像 | 定时任务、Usage 用量页 | **怎么选**：想让 Bot 在 IM 里以自己的身份工作、想用 Git 审阅和同步记忆，试试 DeepSeekBot；想在 DSH 里由主 Bot 一步步带着建团队、关注 token 用量，试试 DS Bot。两者都开源，欢迎都去读读源码：[DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)。更详细的对比见[官网文章](https://deepseekbot.app/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/)。 ## 常见问题 ### 这是哪个 DeepSeek Bot 项目？ 这里是 **BotHarness 的 DeepSeekBot（DSB）**：安装包为 [`deepseekbot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseekbot)，官网为 [deepseekbot.app](https://deepseekbot.app)。DS Bot 使用 `ds-bot`，是另一个独立项目，不是本产品的简称或旧版本，区别见[上文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ### DeepSeekBot 只能使用 DeepSeek 模型吗？ 不是。它使用 DSH 中配置的模型提供商；能否接入取决于接口支持、模型配置与凭据。Bot 的记忆和聊天记录保存在自己的宿主，调用远程模型时相关上下文仍会发给所选服务商。 ## 开发者 想从源码运行或参与开发：需要 Node ≥22 和 pnpm。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` 更多见[本地实例指南](docs/client-bridge.md#7-本地开发环路dsh-020-rc1) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [架构](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [架构决策](docs/adr/) · [Agent 开发规范](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.zh.md) · [DSH 官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 ## 社区 问题、想法，还有你做出来的 Bot，都欢迎带来。 - **Discord**：[加入 DeepSeekBot 服务器](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) - **QQ 群**：在 QQ 中搜索群号 **1125565676** - **使用求助、想法与作品分享**：[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) · [欢迎帖](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1397) - **明确的 Bug 与实施任务**：[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose) - **参与维护**：[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) · [第一次贡献](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398)，文档、测试和答疑也欢迎。 ## 灵感与致谢 - [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/bot)：持久 Bot，以及像同事一样沟通和委派工作的产品灵感。 - [Rakazo](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo)：持久 AI 队友、对话与记忆体验参考。 - [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)：同样运行在 DSH 上的另一个 Bot 插件，重心不同，值得一读。 - [deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin](https://github.com/loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin)：Memory Git graph 分支线、提交列表与 diff 呈现参考。 - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：上游插件宿主。 - [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im)、[dsh-lark-link](https://github.com/amlyczz/dsh-lark-link) 与 [dsh-lark-bridge](https://github.com/imetn/dsh-lark-bridge)：IM 接入基础与可靠性、路由参考。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Client Bundle 中分发的第三方素材见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](packages/client/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ## Star History **BotHarness/DeepSeekBot** 的实时 Star 历史，使用 [Star History 官方嵌入方式](https://www.star-history.com/blog/how-to-use-github-star-history/#how-to-embed-the-chart-in-your-readme)。

# dsh-redops — DSH 红队行动记录与渗透测试模式

面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）的授权红队 engagement 工作台：在授权范围内记录目标与授权、拆解意图、留证事实、确认漏洞与资产，并在 Web 中以链路图、漏洞和资产视图实时展示，支持跨会话历史与 8 种报告格式。

本仓库是自包含 bundle 包（`dsh-redops`）：宿主插件、Web 界面和 sqlite 后端通过包内 `exports` 一同分发，单个 tarball 即可安装。

> **关于来源：** 本项目的功能本体来自 [howmp/dsh-pentest](https://github.com/howmp/dsh-pentest)，由 [shine-233/dsh-redteam](https://github.com/shine-233/dsh-redteam) 二次开发，本仓库在其基础上做 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x 适配与缺陷修复。**功能集与上游 `v1.10.0`（master）一致，没有删减**。三者均为 MIT，详见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

> **为什么会有这个仓库：** 上游最后推送于 2026-09-12，未跟进 DSH `0.2.0-rc.1` 的 agent-presets 机制变更，因此在 0.2.x 上无法注册预设，29 个工具全部不可用；其发布包自 v1.2.0 起还带有三处静默缺陷（含一处使子代理只读围栏完全失效）。本仓库在修复这些问题之外不做功能改动。

## 宿主版本要求

**DSH `^0.2.0-rc.1`**，实测于 `0.2.0-rc.2`。

peer 范围是显式声明的（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 全部为 `^0.2.0-rc.1`），所以 dsh 自身的兼容性门禁会真正生效——上游写的 `>=0.1.0-rc.2` 没有上限，导致不兼容版本被放行。

本分支**不支持 0.1.x**。`src/preset-root.ts` 保留了旧 `resolvedRoots` 接口的回退代码，但未在 0.1.x 上验证。

## 相对上游的修复

上游发布包在 0.2.x 上有三处会导致预设无法注册，另有一处会静默失效：

| # | 问题 | 后果 | 本分支的处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `preset-root` 无条件读取 `agentPresets.resolvedRoots` | 0.2.x 上抛 `Cannot read properties of undefined`，**预设注册失败，29 个工具全部不可用** | 优先走 0.2.x 的 `register()`，仅在其缺席时回退旧接口；用宿主 include loader 加载包内 YAML |
| 2 | commander persona 用 `text:` | rc.2 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 强制要求 `prefix:`，校验失败 | 改为 `prefix:` |
| 3 | preset 引用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-worker-thread` | 该包在 0.1.6 已改名，rc.2 不存在，组内加载失败 | 改为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc` |
| 4 | 两个子代理的 `toolFilter:` 键被并进乱码行 | deny 名单变成 persona 字符串的尾巴，**执行子代理的只读围栏完全不生效**，子代理可自行创建 goal、发报告、继续委派 | 恢复为真正的 `toolFilter` 映射（各 29 条） |
| 5 | `preset/redteam/agent.cordis.yml` 中文乱码 | 注释与两个子代理 persona 为损坏文本（U+E0xx 私有区字符，多轮编码损坏，不可逆） | 注释重写为英文；persona 以干净的上游 `howmp/dsh-pentest` 文本为底本重建，再补上本包特有的 evidence/credentials/artifacts 字段 |

第 4 项值得单独说明：它不报错，`tests/bundle.spec.ts` 原本只做**文本匹配**，所以围栏失效时测试照样通过。本分支把该测试改为解析 YAML 后断言 `toolFilter.deny` 的结构，并显式检查 deny 名单没有被吞进 persona——修复后该断言在损坏文件上会失败（已验证）。

## 安装

### 从 npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-redops
```

### 从 Release 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/chongfenglaosiji/dsh-redops/releases/latest/download/dsh-redops.tar.gz
```

### 从本地文件安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-redops-<version>.tgz
```

重启 dsh 后，在新会话中选择自动注册的「红队模式」预设。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
pnpm pack:bundle
```

### 关于类型检查的一个坑

`tsconfig.json` 的 `paths` 把 `@deepseek-ai/*` 映射到仓库自带的 `types/` 手写声明（标注为 *pinned against upstream 0.1.1-rc.2*），`vitest.config.mjs` 又把同一批模块 alias 到 `tests/fakes/`。

这带来两个可移植性好处（不需要 dsh checkout 就能构建和跑测试），代价是 **`pnpm typecheck` 与 `pnpm test` 都不校验真实的宿主 API**——本分支修掉的第 1 项就是这么漏过去的。改动宿主交互代码时，请务必在真实 dsh 上装包验证，不要只依赖 CI。

## 与上游（dsh-pentest）的差异

下表为上游 README 原文，描述本包相对 `dsh-pentest` 的能力增量；本分支未改动功能集。

| 能力 | dsh-pentest | dsh-redteam |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 证据链 | 无 | `redteam_add_evidence`（command / output / screenshot / file / url），fact 通过 `evidenceIds` 引用 |
| 跨会话历史 | 单会话作用域，无续跑 | `redteam_engagements` 列出全部历史；新 goal 关闭旧 engagement 但不删除任何记录 |
| 报告格式 | Markdown 渲染 | Markdown（人读）/ JSON（程序消费）双格式，含时间线与严重度分布 |
| 协议语言 | 中文 | `language: 'zh' \| 'en'` 双语配置 |
| 边存储 | edges 表显式存边 | 边从引用（intent.goalId / fact.intentId / finding.intentId / asset.parentId）读取时派生，记录不可能悬空 |
| CVSS 定级 | 无 | finding 给 `cvssVector`（CVSS v3.1 基础向量）即按 FIRST 规范自动计算分值 |
| MITRE ATT&CK | 无 | finding 可映射 `techniqueIds`（如 T1110.003），写入时校验格式 |
| Kill-chain 阶段 | 无 | intent / fact 可标 phase（recon / enumeration / exploitation / post-exploitation / reporting） |
| 凭据追踪 | 无 | `redteam_add_credential` 登记口令/哈希/API key/token，Web 视图与报告自动脱敏，明文只进本地库；`redteam_update_credential` 验证后更新 valid/invalid 并留证 |
| 任务树生命周期 | 无（PentestGPT PTT 风格） | intent 有 active/done/blocked 状态，`redteam_update_intent` 推进；UI 进度板与报告进度行 |
| 漏洞复测闭环 | 无（Strix find-and-fix 风格） | `redteam_retest_finding` 记录 fixed/still-vulnerable 复测结果，报告标注 ✅ 已修复与复测时间 |
| OWASP Top 10 | 无 | finding 可映射 `owaspIds`（如 A01:2021 / A05:2017），写入时校验格式 |
| 资产指纹标签 | 无 | asset 可挂 tags（服务名/组件/版本），资产表与报告展示 |

## 架构速览

- **领域模型**（`src/spec.ts`）：storage domain `redteam`（version 1，增量演进兼容旧库）——`goals` / `intents` / `facts` / `assets` / `findings` / `evidence` / `credentials` 七张表。goal 按会话键控，其余记录 id 为 `<kind>-<n>`（按会话计数，重开 goal 归零）。
- **确定性 id**（`src/store.ts`）：工具返回 id 供模型跨调用引用；会话投影从日志纯重放同一张图。
- **工具**（`src/tools.ts`）：29 个 —— `redteam_add_goal`（authorization 必填，重开 goal 关闭旧 engagement）/ `redteam_add_intent`（可选 phase）/ `redteam_add_evidence` / `redteam_add_fact`（evidenceIds 引用、可选 phase）/ `redteam_add_asset`（parentId 留空为根资产，tags 指纹）/ `redteam_add_finding`（reproducibleSteps 必填；cvssVector 支持 v3.1 与 v4.0 自动算分；techniqueIds/owaspIds 校验；SLA 按策略盖章）/ `redteam_add_credential`（凭据登记，脱敏展示）/ `redteam_update_intent`（任务树状态推进）/ `redteam_retest_finding`（复测闭环）/ `redteam_flag_finding`（DefectDojo 式分诊：误报/范围外/风险接受/审核中）/ `redteam_update_credential`(验证凭据) / `redteam_submit`（子 agent 分批直写指定父 intent）/ `redteam_add_scope`（结构化授权边界 in/out）/ `redteam_add_operator`（协作角色注册）/ `redteam_import_scan`（nmap/Nessus XML 摄取）/ `redteam_jira_export|redteam_jira_apply`（JIRA 双向桥）/ `redteam_state`（含 nextSteps 建议与凭据复用、范围合规、SLA 逾期）/ `redteam_search`（12 类记录跨表检索）/ `redteam_overview`（部署级全局度量）/ `redteam_graph` / `redteam_report`（markdown|html|json|sarif|navlayer|stix|taxii|ioc-csv）/ `redteam_engagements`（历史列表）。
- **CVSS 计算**（`src/cvss.ts`）：FIRST CVSS v3.1 基础分实现（含官方 roundup 防浮点漂移），20 个参考向量测试覆盖。
- **会话投影**（`src/projection.ts`）：折叠已日志化的 `redteam_*` 调用为 `{ goal, nodes, assets, findings, credentials, counts }`，镜像 store 的引用拒绝；密文永不进入投影。
- **Web 标签页**（`src/client/`）：按会话注册（当前会话或祖先链含 redteam 预设即显示）；十二个子标签——链路（canvas 力导向图：拖拽/缩放/悬停高亮/点选详情抽屉——事实节点显示真实详情与证据引用/方向粒子流）、统计（严重度环形图、任务树与覆盖度动画进度条、ATT&CK 覆盖墙、防御触达率、kill-chain 泳道、范围合规）、立体（零依赖 3D 攻击地形：轨道旋转/推拉/自动旋转/深度排序）、漏洞（检测徽章+重复标记）、资产、凭据（脱敏列表）、产物、证据（证据元数据+事实清单，内容不进视图）、样本、IOC（类型筛选）、目标（crown-jewel 清单）、报告。13 张表全部有可视化入口。
- **协议**（`src/instructions.ts`）：系统提示词段 `redteam:protocol`（order 50），双语逐字撰写而非运行时翻译；要求授权留痕、事实必留证、漏洞必可复现、凭据不落明文。

## 已知边界

- **数据库**：红队记录写入 `$DSH_HOME/storages/redteam.db`（sqlite，经 bundle 补丁路由）。宿主其它域的存储不受影响（仍为宿主默认 json 后端）。
- **授权**：只测试有授权的目标。`authorization` 是必填审计事实（授权对象/书面许可引用），写入状态与最终报告留痕；它不是门禁——扫描/利用动作仍受部署沙箱与审批约束。
- **Web 图为窗口视图**：投影有节点上限，超出后最旧被逐出；完整记录以 `redteam_state` / `redteam_report`（读存储层）为准。
- **运行时要求**：sqlite 后端使用 Node.js `node:sqlite`，需 Node.js >= 22.5（engines: `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`）。
